status: Native group disclosure and collapse-all tested and packaged; live Photoshop qualification pending
implementation: Validated group expansion metadata updates preserve undo/redo snapshots, coalescing, active/multiselection and clean/dirty state.
Ordinary disclosure toggles one group; Option-click applies its new state to all groups, including locked, hidden and nested groups; Collapse All Groups is a guarded Layers panel action.

Native 14×36 AppKit disclosure controls draw source-derived filled triangles and own click/modifier/cancel/stale-input handling outside the row reorder region. Mouse-down additionally binds the unique runtime store identity, preventing stale release into a separately opened copy with identical persisted UUIDs.
Existing row filtering is extracted without semantic changes; search/kind filters still find descendants of collapsed groups.
Native and PSD open/closed metadata persistence and exact unchanged native rendered samples at all three depths are tested.
Development-history audit now distinguishes crashed XCTest processes from earlier passing suite summaries.
limits: Physical pointer/modifier/keyboard and accessibility delivery, exact Photoshop panel menu ordering/geometry and clean/history/lock semantics remain pending an unlocked Mac.
Native/PSD self-roundtrip and render invariance do not establish Photoshop-wide byte equivalence.
Undo restores the source history snapshots, which can include earlier group disclosure flags; exact Photoshop behavior remains unqualified.
Active-layer ancestor reveal/minimal scrolling, Panel Options and remaining professional editing functions are incomplete.
